subject.title: fix(ci): preserve QA package intent boundaries

question: Should the explicit false-default packaging-intent contract be refreshed onto current main and landed with current-tree smoke opting in and focused release checks remaining strict?
rationale: The patch is correct and proven, but it controls a release-validation boundary and carries a protected maintainer label, so the final acceptance of that automation policy belongs to the workflow owner.

options.title: Refresh and land
options.body: Run the normal exact-head merge gates on current main and merge if the two caller policies remain green.

options.title: Hold for another caller requirement
options.body: Pause only if another supported install-smoke caller requires a different packaging policy that the boolean contract does not represent.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land
recommendation.body: Run the normal exact-head merge gates on current main and merge if the two caller policies remain green.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history and CODEOWNERS evidence connects this person to the package-intent and workflow boundary being changed.
